seoDescription: Blood of the Seven is Book I of The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari by Njintieuh Sieni — an African epic fantasy of seven kingdoms, sacred animal spirits, and an ancient evil returning as the old seals weaken. Read the synopsis and get the book.
eyebrow: The Seven Kingdoms of K'Thari · Book I
title: Blood of the Seven
tagline: Seven kingdoms. Seven sacred animals. One dying crown.
synopsis:
The Oracle did not die quietly. She died screaming — not from pain, but from knowing. With her last breath, the Age of One Crown begins to end, and the ancient seals that bound the seven kingdoms for generations start to fail.

Across a continent of rivers, mountains, and hidden deltas, seven peoples reckon with a truth their ancestors buried: an evil old enough to remember the making of the world is stirring again — and the Owl, who rules no kingdom but watches them all, has begun to move.
quote: Game of Thrones scale — built on African cosmology, not European myth.
mapHeading: Maps of K'Thari are intentionally incomplete
mapText: Borders shift. Kingdoms rise and fall. Power is never still. What is drawn today may not exist tomorrow.
kingdomsText: Each kingdom is bound to an animal spirit and a philosophy of power. When the seals weaken, they do not fall equally.
closingText: Blood of the Seven is available now in eBook and paperback everywhere books are sold.
